reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: W. S. Marshall, 19th cent.: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 000812 (the melody read from 000812a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. James M. Kirk's dates (1854–1945) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Kirk_James (Kirk, James M., 1854-1945; James McPherson Kirk); https://www.umcdiscipleship.org/articles/history-of-hymns-joys-are-flowing-like-a-river-blessed-quietness agrees (arranger of BLESSED QUIETNESS); CCEH's page gives only the year 1900. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1900, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000812a.nwc).
